author: Chilling Tales for Dark Nights
title: Horror Illustrators Wanted - Paid Opportunities
content:
HORROR ILLUSTRATORS WANTED — PAID OPPORTUNITIES

Chilling Tales for Dark Nights is looking for a handful of talented horror illustrators to create original artwork for us throughout the remainder of 2026 and into 2027.

If you have a talent for bringing nightmares to life—from unsettling atmosphere to terrifying creatures—we’d love to see your work.

Experience with illustrated lettering or incorporating text into your artwork is a plus, but not required.

These are paid gigs. We’re seeking human-created artwork only for this particular endeavor. We won’t accept AI-generated or AI-assisted artwork. (Yes, we're aware AI art has appeared on our channel before, and we'd love to return to using human artists full-time once the budget supports it, and this is part of that plan.) 

Interested? Email Craig Groshek with your portfolio, rates, and availability:

Email: craiggroshek [at] https://t.co/huxOivDeXU
Subject line: CTFDN ARTIST INTEREST

Know a talented artist who would be a great fit? Tag them below or share this post to help us find them!

#ChillingTalesForDarkNights #HorrorArt #HorrorIllustration #ArtistsWanted #PaidArtOpportunities

title: Looking for artist for Pokemon card show banner
content: In the anti trend of AI generated flyers at Pokemon card shows, I’m looking for an artist that can make a banner and also handle the logistics of printing a banner with two poles and ship it to my place.
